commands: jq '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type | contains("Subnet") or contains("NetworkInterface")) | {type, urn, id: .outputs.id, subnetId: .outputs.subnetId, region: .outputs.availabilityZone}' /tmp/pulumi-state.json | head -100
jq '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type | contains("NetworkInterface") or contains("Eni")) | {type, urn, subnetId: .outputs.subnetId}' /tmp/pulumi-state.json
jq '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet")' /tmp/pulumi-state.json | jq -s 'map({urn, subnetId: .outputs.id, region: .outputs.availabilityZone}) | sort_by(.region)'

jq '.deployment.resources[] | select(.outputs.subnetId != null and .outputs.subnetId != "") | {type, urn, subnetId: .outputs.subnetId}' /tmp/pulumi-state.json | jq -s 'group_by(.subnetId) | map({subnetId: .[0].subnetId, resourceCount: length, resources: map(.type)})'

cat > /tmp/analyze_subnets.jq << 'EOF' # Get all subnets managed by Pulumi def get_subnets: .deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet") | {urn, subnetId: .outputs.id, region: .outputs.availabilityZone}; # Get all resources that reference a subnet def get_subnet_references: .deployment.resources[] | select(.outputs.subnetId != null and .outputs.subnetId != "") | {type, urn, subnetId: .outputs.subnetId}; # Get all instances with their subnet def get_instances: .deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/instance:Instance") | {urn, subnetId: .outputs.subnetId}; # Main logic { subnets: [get_subnets], instancesBySubnet: ([get_instances] | group_by(.subnetId) | map({subnetId: .[0].subnetId, instances: map(.urn)})), allResourcesBySubnet: ([get_subnet_references] | group_by(.subnetId) | map({subnetId: .[0].subnetId, resources: length})) } EOF jq -f /tmp/analyze_subnets.jq /tmp/pulumi-state.json

jq '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet") | {urn, subnetId: .outputs.id, region: .outputs.availabilityZone | split("-")[0:-1] | join("-")}' /tmp/pulumi-state.json | jq -s 'unique_by(.region)'

jq '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet") | {urn, subnetId: .outputs.id, az: .outputs.availabilityZone, region: (.outputs.availabilityZone | gsub("[a-z]$"; ""))}' /tmp/pulumi-state.json | jq -s 'group_by(.region) | map({region: .[0].region, subnets: map({subnetId, urn})})'

cat > /tmp/final_analysis.jq << 'EOF' # Get all managed subnets def get_all_subnets: .deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet") | {urn, subnetId: .outputs.id, az: .outputs.availabilityZone, region: (.outputs.availabilityZone | gsub("[a-z]$"; ""))}; # Get all resources with network interfaces in subnets (instances, ENIs, etc.) def get_resources_with_eni: .deployment.resources[] | select(.outputs.subnetId != null and .outputs.subnetId != "") | {type, urn, subnetId: .outputs.subnetId, name: (.urn | split("::")[-1])}; # Build map of subnet -> resources def build_subnet_map: [get_resources_with_eni] | group_by(.subnetId) | map({subnetId: .[0].subnetId, resources: map({type, name})}); [get_all_subnets] as $subnets | build_subnet_map as $subnet_map | { subnets_by_region: ($subnets | group_by(.region) | map({region: .[0].region, subnets: map({subnetId, az, urn})})), empty_subnets: ( $subnets | map(select(.subnetId as $sid | $subnet_map | map(.subnetId) | index($sid) | not)) | map({subnetId, region, az}) ), subnets_with_resources: $subnet_map } EOF jq -f /tmp/final_analysis.jq /tmp/pulumi-state.json

commands: cat /tmp/pulumi-state.json | jq '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/vpc:Vpc") | {urn, id: .outputs.id, region: .outputs.cidrBlock}' 2>/dev/null | head -50

cat > /tmp/vpc_analysis.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash # Extract all VPCs with their IDs echo "=== ALL VPCS IN STATE ===" jq -r '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/vpc:Vpc") | "\(.outputs.id) - \(.urn)"' /tmp/pulumi-state.json echo "" echo "=== ALL SUBNETS WITH VPC MAPPING ===" jq -r '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet") | "\(.outputs.id) -> \(.outputs.vpcId)"' /tmp/pulumi-state.json echo "" echo "=== ALL EC2 INSTANCES WITH SUBNET MAPPING ===" jq -r '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/instance:Instance") | "\(.outputs.id) in subnet \(.outputs.subnetId)"' /tmp/pulumi-state.json echo "" echo "=== ANALYSIS ===" # Get all VPC IDs vpc_ids=$(jq -r '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/vpc:Vpc") | .outputs.id' /tmp/pulumi-state.json | sort -u) # Get all subnets and their VPC IDs declare -A subnet_to_vpc while IFS='|' read -r subnet vpc; do subnet_to_vpc["$subnet"]="$vpc" done < <(jq -r '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet") | "\(.outputs.id)|\(.outputs.vpcId)"' /tmp/pulumi-state.json) # Get all instances and their subnets declare -A instance_to_subnet while IFS='|' read -r instance subnet; do instance_to_subnet["$instance"]="$subnet" done < <(jq -r '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/instance:Instance") | "\(.outputs.id)|\(.outputs.subnetId)"' /tmp/pulumi-state.json) # Map each VPC to instances declare -A vpc_instances for vpc_id in $vpc_ids; do vpc_instances["$vpc_id"]="" done for instance_id in "${!instance_to_subnet[@]}"; do subnet_id="${instance_to_subnet[$instance_id]}" vpc_id="${subnet_to_vpc[$subnet_id]}" if [ -n "$vpc_id" ]; then vpc_instances["$vpc_id"]+="$instance_id " fi done # Report echo "VPC Analysis:" for vpc_id in $vpc_ids; do instances="${vpc_instances[$vpc_id]}" if [ -z "$instances" ]; then echo "✗ $vpc_id - NO INSTANCES" else echo "✓ $vpc_id - has instances: $instances" fi done EOF chmod +x /tmp/vpc_analysis.sh /tmp/vpc_analysis.sh
